Maintain realistic continuity throughout: phone and earphones are placed into the pajama pocket before she drinks water, water bottle remains in her possession afterward, shoelace is visibly untied before she fixes it and properly tied afterward.

Baddie went for a little walk

Seedance 2.5

Prompt :

Create a 30-second ultra-realistic personal home-video of a young Korean woman enjoying a relaxed Sunday afternoon in an older Seoul residential neighborhood. Use the attached image as the character reference and keep her face, long black messy side ponytail, fitted pastel-blue top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers, silver necklace and overall appearance perfectly consistent throughout.

She leaves her home with her phone in one hand and earphones in her ears, starts playing music and casually walks down the quiet residential street while listening, gently moving her head to the rhythm and enjoying the peaceful afternoon.

She reaches a tiny neighborhood convenience store, removes one earphone, walks inside and buys a cold bottle of water. She steps outside, puts her phone and earphones safely into the pocket of her pajama pants, then walks toward a nearby neighborhood bench.

She sits comfortably on the bench, opens the water bottle and takes several refreshing sips while looking around at the peaceful street. She wipes a small drop of water from her lips and relaxes for a moment.

Her female friend suddenly appears from the opposite side of the street. They recognize each other, smile brightly and walk toward each other before sharing a warm, natural hug. They briefly chat and laugh together like close friends.

The friend says goodbye and walks away. She picks up her water bottle, gives a small wave and continues walking toward her home while casually carrying the bottle.

A few minutes later, she suddenly notices that one of her shoelaces has come undone. She stops on the sidewalk, bends down naturally, ties the shoelace securely, stands back up and brushes her hands against her pajama pants.

She continues walking toward her house, glances back toward the camera with a relaxed smile and casually says, “Bye!” before turning around and walking away down the quiet residential lane.

Use raw early-2000s consumer DV-camera footage: handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, soft digital detail, mild digital noise, natural motion blur, occasional awkward zooms, slightly faded colors and authentic home-video imperfections.

Natural Seoul neighborhood ambience only — footsteps, distant conversations, convenience-store door chime, traffic, birds, bicycle bells, leaves moving in the breeze, water bottle sounds and quiet street ambience. The music from her earphones should be faintly audible only when appropriate, never as background music for the video.

Maintain realistic continuity throughout: phone and earphones are placed into the pajama pocket before she drinks water, water bottle remains in her possession afterward, shoelace is visibly untied before she fixes it and properly tied afterward.

No music added to the soundtrack, no narration, no subtitles, no captions, no dramatic events, no polished commercial cinematography, no beauty-filter skin, no CGI look, no outfit changes, no identity drift, no duplicated characters, no disappearing objects, no unrealistic movements or changing environment.
